Hi Emma,

Appreciate the clear list — attaching two artifacts: a pricing worksheet with three packaging paths and a proposed evidence delivery timeline. High level options below (see attached CareAxis_residency_options_v2.xlsx):

1) Minimal-residency (pilot)
   - 90-day pilot: EU/US logical residency, shared managed KMS, auditlog retention 90 days
   - One-time onboarding + evidence fee: $45k (covers onboarding, SOC evidence prep, auditlog ingest tooling)
   - No recurring HSM seats. 10% pilot credit if evidence milestones missed

2) Hybrid-residency (recommended)
   - 6–12 month staged residency with dedicated KMS + 1 HSM seat in primary region
   - Onboarding + implementation: $85k, recurring evidence support: $2.5k/mo
   - Credit model: 30% of onboarding fee refundable pro-rata if evidence milestones delayed beyond agreed windows (6 months risk-share)

3) Enterprise-residency (full)
   - Dedicated residency with HSM cluster, multi-region auditlog retention tiers
   - Onboarding: $175k, recurring evidence package: $7.5k/mo (includes SOC refresh and dedicated evidence engineer)
   - SLAs and credits: defined SLA-backed credits for missed evidence delivery; no risk-share on onboarding (capitalized)

Notes / constraints:
- Data movement: HIPAA-covered PHI may require VPC/Private deployment; for EU residency we recommend on‑prem or private VPC due to local regs.
- KMS/HSM lead times: procuring HSM seats can add 4–8 weeks to timeline.
- Auditlog ingestion: depends on event volume; we size retention tiers in the workbook.

Next steps I suggest: 1) you pick the packaging path that aligns to CareAxis’s risk appetite, 2) we run a short SOW sketch, and 3) align procurement on credit timing.

I’ve put Jonas and Ben in-loop — Jonas will confirm commercial flexibility, Ben can clarify implementation cadence. Happy to jump on a 30-minute call tomorrow.
